notes.title: Release News!
notes.notes:
Hey all, Ordinary Day is currently under review for release!

Ordinary Day will be [b]FREE[/b], this has come at a cost, we have had to stop production on the expansion, we realized it's not really that fun and takes away from what made Ordinary Day a fun little experience in the first place, originally the game was going to release paid, doing this now with the expansion cut would be a bad move so we've dedicated our time to polishing what we do have, adding new content, fixing issues, polishing, translations, achievements, etc.

We will be looking in to further adding some new content to the base game post release as well which of course will all be free, currently we're happy with the state of the game and happy to call it complete.

When the time has come for release we will notify everyone in our servers and on Steam, thank you to all who have wishlisted Ordinary Day, we look forward to seeing everyone share their feedback and discover the little secrets (we definitely have some strange ones we can't wait for people to find).

notes.title: A quick update on development!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]How's it going?[/b][/h1]
Well, the longest part has been the catacombs from the expansion, NekOz has been working on it on/off for a while and he's finally considered it complete enough to move on to the next segment, the remaining segments are in their blockout phase and hopefully will be much quicker to complete.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43379647/ac43ce1382b414162b562e3ede7a64ea22b154f3.png[/img]


[h3][b]Of course, what you see may change![/b] [/h3]Oz did a great job on the church exterior too, this is still under work so keep that in mind.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43379647/422f5dc5bc41b2c96f57fc87ac7a1e4cf330515f.png[/img]

Hope you like the little lantern sway, feels pretty good! The hands do move too, makes it a little less static.
[previewyoutube=bQx5Ukv8iKI;full][/previewyoutube]

Hope this was a nice little update, we're excited to release OD however we still have some work to do till then, consider sharing this around, your support helps a lot, thank you to all who have wishlisted OD!
